hook.name: UnihoodStockHook
hook.description: A tokenized-stock-denominated meme coin launch hook with per-pool fixed swap fees (0–5%), split 80% creator / 5% bid wall / 15% platform. Collects fees in the quote token on each swap, maintains a single-sided bid wall below spot price from accrued wall fees, locks external liquidity pre-graduation, and detects graduation when the pool tick crosses a configured threshold.
